verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an official MCP server and Skills so AI assistants can design, run, and improve evaluations. It also has a guide for using Cekura from Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot, plus a CLI, SDK, and OpenAPI spec for programmatic access to runs and call data. Together these give an agent API/MCP access to eval results and call logs for debugging. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP tools query traces and metric results (rather than only run evaluations), no detail on trace-level query endpoints, and no independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.
